strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: a yi keybox mato ma a nun Google xa revocation list (CRL) a nun a source wuyaxi mato ma han a keybox fangni sOtO, a nun a xa backup a yEtE ra a nun a xa Google walie ra. A na walife a birin na a man wama internet nan xOn (1-3 miniti).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: a keybox tongo ma a xa repository (GitHub) a nun a ragata /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. A hayi na internet ma a nun miniti 1-3 nan tongo ma. A usi ma tEmui na xan ma smart fetch mu nOma rabade xa na mu keybox masarama tEmui na xan ma.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: checks the available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspects TEE attestation certificate version, and shows the KmInstallKeybox tool state. Sese mu masarama — a masinie xa fe ma tofe.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. A mu sese masarama.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. A lanma a xa seedeɲɔxɔya fe yailan xa na mu a ra a xa passe automatique mu nɔma rabade. Gi birin a masenxi nE a fangni/xOrOxOE.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. A fe xOrOxEe ra bama a man waxati gbegbe tongo ma. A yabi fiixE nan mini ma a ra ɲɔnfe ra.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: Play Store nun Google walie (GMS+GSF) kEdie ra bama a nun a masini ra gbilen ma a yEtE ra. A lanma a xa findi seedeɲɔxɔya ra — a mu wo xa fotoe xa na mu wo xa bukie makɔrɛma abadan.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: a matoma RKP sErtifika sEmbE ra naxan na masini kui a man sEmbE so ma sEmbE ra xa a lan ma. A mu lanma a xa user data ma.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. A usi ma masine ndee nan ma na xan e xaxili tixi SOTER ra a nun Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Wo bElExE sugandixi sa (local/advanced) a nun pif.prop/pif.json sEbEli. A yabi fiixE nan minixi kEdi kui.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF matofe: a ma senxi motEri naxan na a kui, a bElExE sEbEli (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), a nun kEdi. Wo xa a mato gbansan — a mu sese masarama.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Canary Engine xa fe nEnE tongo fe ala ko a xa lan a nun RKP sErtifika (fevrie 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • MotEr ma tofe: TrickyStoreOSS state mato ma (pid, logs), keybox file (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display gbansan.
strings.btnKbSlotsPreferSecondary: 🔁 A firin de rafan wo ma
strings.hintKbSlots: Na module na keybox firin nan ma: a singe (a sEnxi, a mu kanama abada) a nun a firin de (a ragataxi). Yi tab a ma senxi slot mundun na walife, a sugandi masarama, xa na mu a firin de ra tima a singe ma maxOrin gni ma — a nun backups a nun a full log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Xaran gbansan — a mu sese masarama.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
#000#s are services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: a ma senxi slot singe nun a firin de nan na a nun a sugandi masarama e tagi. A singe (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) a makantaxi tEmui birin a man mu kanama abadan. A firin de ra te fe singe ma a lan ma a xa sEmbE so a ma.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promotion the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Conue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Clear the secondary slot:

• The primary slot is not touched.

Continue?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox with the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts #000## services.

⚠️ IntErnEt nan maxOxun ma (1-3 min). Aman kharaba?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox from the internet:

• Downloads the official keybox and validate it.
• Installed permanently (never reverted at boot).

⚠️ Needs internet (han 1 min). Aman kharaba?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• No data or keybox files are deleted.
• Reboot the phone afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Yayilanfe birin:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• The device reboots automatically (nothing is wiped).

Continue?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — restart only.
• Nothing is wiped and you will NOT be signed out.
• The device reboots automatically.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• For devices that ignore the leaked keybox.
• Works even if the keys are healthy.
• No data is deleted.

Continue?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Clears only the Store cache — your account is untouched.
• Reboot, then open the Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Restarts the vendor.soter service.
• Cleers the SOTER server data only.

Continue?
strings.confirmPifApply:

• A lan ma a xa gbilen a fOlOde na xanbi.
strings.confirmCanary:
